messages:
Ava (People Ops): quick heads-up — we've finished drafting a short handbook annex for data residency (impacts teams that touch EU/UK customer data). please read the summary at the top: https://redwood.docs/internal/handbook/data-residency-addendum
Keaton (Legal): skimmed it. one wording tweak: change "indefinitely stored" to "retained per retention schedule". i'll push a small patch now.
Jules (Eng Manager): clarify scope: who has to sign — managers only or ICs as well?
Ava (People Ops): managers + any ICs with prod data access. contractors restricted to non-prod only will get a separate checkbox flow. we'll attach a CSV of scope after this thread.
Marta (People Ops EMEA): can we run two live training slots for EMEA? i can host 10:00 & 16:00 GMT next Tue/Wed. prefer Tue if enough folks.
Ava (People Ops): planning calendar blocks. signup form: https://forms.redwood/workplace/residency-training — RSVP by EOD Fri. tentative: EMEA Tue 10:00 GMT; US Wed 9:00 PT.
Samir (Manager-NA): signed the doc, left a comment re: shared S3 buckets. :white_check_mark:
hr-bot: Compliance task updated — Samir (Manager-NA) marked "Data residency addendum" complete. (compliance id: CR-2026-45)
Priya (Sales): will customer-facing sales need scripts or a quick Q&A doc to explain this to customers?
Ava (People Ops): yes, we'll publish a short FAQ and a 2-line email template. will drop into #customer-success and the sales playbook later today.
Keaton (Legal): retention wording pushed. no legal blockers otherwise. recommend managers confirm team lists before signoff.
Jules (Eng Manager): doing an inventory now, will flag any contractors that need escalation.
Leo (People Ops Intern): sample CSV export for manager signoff:
```
manager,team,signoff_ts,status
Samir,Payments,2798768901,complete
Jules,Search,2798770002,pending
```
Ava (People Ops): action items recap:
• managers: review doc + e-sign by next Friday
• people-ops: finalize FAQ + email template (Ava, Leo)
• legal: confirm wording (Keaton)
• ops: inventory contractors with prod access (Jules)
I'll post a reminder and upload the master CSV to the shared drive. thanks all :pray:
Marta (People Ops EMEA): i'll add EMEA zoom links to the calendar and ping region leads.
Priya (Sales): RSVP'd for Wed US session. thanks!
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled — manager signoff deadline in 6 days (2798772032).
